name: Animated Sparkle Text
description: Large headline whose letters bounce, tilt and scale in a staggered wave on hover while a Lottie sparkle animation plays behind the text with a glowing accent shadow.
contents: Headline text split into per-letter spans
Lottie sparkle canvas centered over the text
behavior: Hovering the headline staggers each letter with translate, rotate and scale
Lottie sparkle fades in and plays on hover, pauses on leave
Text glow switches to the accent color on hover

props.name: hintText
props.default: Hover over the text to trigger magic physics

editableByProps: Headline text, hint text, font size and font classes

needsCodeEdit.change: Change per-letter rotation and scale pattern
needsCodeEdit.where: rotationOffset and scaleOffset constants inside characters.map

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Idle text glow uses a fixed faint gold shadow
